review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.description: Привіт! Meest China запрошує в команду! Хто ми? Ми — команда лідерів ринку з доставки з Китаю, яка вже 12 років створює тренди в логістиці та закохує клієнтів у найкращий сервіс. Кого ми шукаємо? Product manager — експерта, який підсилить нашу команду, відповідатиме за розвиток продуктового напрямку: збір та формалізацію верхньорівневих вимог бізнесу, трансформацію їх у реалізовані технічною командою проекти (інтеграції з партнерами, розвиток API), забезпечить дотримання строків та прозорий зворотний зв’язку бізнесу щодо статусу робіт. Гарантуємо тобі: Міжнародний досвід: міжнародні та амбітні проєкти в компанії, яка не просто пливе за течією, а задає тренди у міжнародній логістиці. Гібридний формат роботи: міксуй продуктивні дні вдома (3 дні для віддаленої роботи на тиждень) та в нашому комфортному офісі (біля ст. метро «Деміївська»). Комфортний та гнучкий графік: працюємо з понеділка по четвер з 8:00/9:00/10:00 до 17:00/18:00/19:00, а в п’ятницю влаштовуємо легкий старт вихідних і йдемо додому на годину раніше — о 16:00/17:00/18:00 відповідно. Базові речі, які навіть не обговорюються: стабільна й конкурентна зарплата, офіційне працевлаштування, оплачувані відпустки та лікарняні — це наш залізобетонний стандарт і твоя безпека. Benefit Cafe (наша унікальна фішка): уже після 3-х місяців роботи ти отримуєш квартальний ліміт і сам збираєш свій соцпакет, наче страви в меню! Спорт, стоматологія, психолог, навчання, квитки в кіно чи на концерти або навіть гаджети для Home Office — міксуй під власні бажання. Додатковий відпочинок: ми цінуємо твій баланс, тому окрім стандартної відпустки, ми маємо додаткові вихідні дні на державні та релігійні свята. Корпоративне життя: у нас крута корпоративна культура та, де робота поєднується з драйвом. На тебе чекають яскраві івенти, тім-дні, стильний брендований мерч та внутрішня програма лояльності (спеціальні знижки та пропозиції для наших працівників). Підтримку на старті: турботливий та структурований онбординг, щоб ти швидко розібрався в наших процесах, познайомився з командою та почувався впевнено з першого дня. Простір для розвитку та ідей: вільний обмін думками без зайвої бюрократії. Кожна твоя ініціатива буде почута, а для прокачки скілів ти матимеш доступ до корисних курсів та нашої великої корпоративної бібліотеки. Твої основні обов’язки: Збір верхньорівневих вимог від бізнесу, виявлення реальних потреб та їх накладання на поточні бізнес-процеси. Формалізація та декомпозиція вимог: підготовка задач для технічної команди, ведення беклогу напрямку. Оцінка задач разом з командою розробки, планування робіт, пріоритезація. Ведення проектів інтеграцій з партнерами (в т.ч. міжнародними) та доробок API під вимоги бізнесу. Взаємодія з Technical Product Owner: узгодження технічних змін та змін архітектури Контроль дотримання строків, регулярний зворотний зв’язок бізнесу щодо статусів і термінів. Комунікація з зовнішніми партнерами щодо інтеграцій. Управління roadmap розвитку продукту. Бізнес-проєктування та контроль інтеграцій між ERP-системою та міжнародними маркетплейсами. Аналіз бізнес-процесів компанії та їх трансформація в системні рішення. Забезпечення стабільної роботи всіх інтеграцій та їх масштабованості. Контроль якості реалізації функціоналу. Проєктування масштабованої архітектури для підключення нових країн, логістичних операторів та платіжних систем. Для роботи тобі знадобляться: Досвід роботи Product Manager / Project Manager / Product Owner від 2−3 років або Business Analyst — 4−5 років. Досвід у сфері e-commerce (маркетплейси, логістика для e-commerce, B2B-інтеграції). Досвід роботи з технічними командами розробки, розуміння життєвого циклу розробки ПЗ. Навички збору, аналізу та формалізації бізнес-вимог, написання ТЗ/user stories; декомпозиції задач, оцінки та планування разом з командою. Розуміння принципів роботи API (REST, вебхуки) на рівні постановки задач, досвід роботи з Jira/Confluence; знання Agile/Scrum/Kanban. Досвід ведення інтеграційних проектів (API, взаємодія із зовнішніми партнерами). Знання англійської мови на рівні Upper-Intermediate (B2). review_candidates.description: Summary As an Investment Director , you will take a senior leadership role in evaluating, structuring, and executing investment and M&A transactions within an Investment Firm. You will be responsible for leading complex transactions, shaping investment strategies, overseeing transaction execution, and managing senior-level relationships with clients, investors, financial institutions, and other stakeholders. The role combines investment analysis, transaction structuring, M&A execution, portfolio management, and strategic decision-making across a broad range of investment opportunities and geographies. In addition to transaction responsibilities, the Investment Director will participate in the governance of portfolio companies, including serving as a Board Director on the boards of portfolio companies and contributing to key strategic, financial, and corporate decisions. Responsibilities: Lead the evaluation, structuring, and execution of complex investment and M&A transactions. Develop investment strategies, transaction structures, valuation frameworks, and investment theses. Take overall responsibility for transaction execution from initial assessment through due diligence, negotiations, documentation, and closing. Lead negotiations with senior-level clients, investors, financial institutions, strategic counterparties, and advisors. Evaluate financial, commercial, strategic, and transaction risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies. Review and challenge financial models, valuations, investment cases, due diligence findings, and key transaction assumptions. Lead and coordinate legal, financial, tax, technical, commercial, and other external advisors. Prepare and present investment recommendations, investment committee materials, transaction proposals, and strategic analyses to senior stakeholders. Oversee the preparation, review, negotiation, and execution of transaction documentation, including term sheets, offers, investment agreements, acquisition agreements, financing documentation, shareholder agreements, and other relevant legal and transaction documents. Manage transaction teams and oversee the work of Vice Presidents, Associates, and Analysts. Provide strategic direction and ensure high-quality execution across multiple transactions. Monitor the performance and strategic development of portfolio companies. Participate as a Board Director on the boards of portfolio companies, contributing to strategic, financial, governance, and corporate decisions. Review portfolio company performance, business plans, budgets, financing requirements, and strategic initiatives. Work closely with management teams of portfolio companies and other shareholders on key strategic matters. Contribute to investment decisions, portfolio strategy, capital allocation, and risk management. Represent the Investment Firm in discussions with senior external stakeholders and counterparties. Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field. CFA qualification or progress toward CFA is considered an advantage. 10+ years of relevant experience in investment banking, private equity, investment management, M&A, corporate finance, transaction advisory, or a related field. Proven track record of leading and executing complex investment, M&A, financing, or strategic transactions. Strong expertise in reviewing financial models, valuations, investment cases, due diligence, transaction structuring, and investment analysis. Extensive experience managing transaction processes and leading multidisciplinary teams. Strong understanding of transaction documentation and ability to lead negotiations on key commercial and financial terms. Demonstrated experience working with senior-level clients, investors, financial institutions, shareholders, and management teams. Experience with portfolio company oversight and corporate governance is strongly preferred. Previous experience serving on a Board of Directors / Supervisory Board is an advantage. Strong strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to evaluate complex investment opportunities and make informed decisions. Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Fluency in Russian and English is essential; additional languages are an advantage. review_candidates.title: Integrations Configuration Specialist
review_candidates.description: Eeze is a Malta-based, technology-driven company that has been developing world leading online gaming platforms and solutions since 1999. Underpinned by a history that directly interconnects with the rise of online gambling, the company has been a key pioneer within the international market. Over the years, Eeze has amassed a world-class team of gambling specialists who remain at the frontiers of innovation within this ever-evolving industry. With a focus on being an international B2B Live Casino provider with our Eeze brand, we have over 700 talented team members based in various locations across Europe, with our headquarters and studio in Malta - Europe’s leading iGaming hub. Job Summary The Integrations Configuration Specialist is responsible for managing client facing configuration across our casino and live casino platform. The role supports new client onboarding, portfolio expansion, game and table releases, and ongoing production configuration. The specialist will become the subject matter expert for Backoffice configuration and will be accountable for ensuring that configuration changes are completed accurately, efficiently and safely. They will also play an important role in continuously improving how configuration work is performed by identifying inefficiencies, unnecessary manual steps and operational risks. The role works closely with Integration Managers, Commercial teams, Product Owners and Business Analysts to ensure configuration requirements are understood and delivered effectively, while helping shape improvements to the Backoffice that make configuration simpler, faster and more secure. The Configuration Specialist does not own client relationships, client roadmaps or integration delivery. All work is provided through Integration Managers and Commercial Managers, with overall prioritisation governed by the Integrations and Delivery Manager. Key Responsibilities Client & Portfolio Configuration The Configuration Specialist will manage operator and brand configurations, including game enablement and disablement, lobby and category configuration, and client specific game limits and settings. They will support Integration Managers with client onboarding, portfolio management and production configuration activities, as well as helping coordinate configuration requirements for major game and table releases across multiple operators. Production Configuration & Quality They will be responsible for ensuring that production configuration changes are completed accurately and in line with defined processes, validation requirements and four eye controls. The role will involve troubleshooting configuration issues and identifying when additional clarification or escalation is required before a change is made. Configuration Processes & Ways of Working The configuration specialist will become highly knowledgeable in casino and live casino Backoffice systems and will own the ways of working around configuration activities. They will continuously look for opportunities to make these processes more efficient, consistent and scalable. A key part of the role will be identifying unnecessary manual steps, inefficient workflows and potential configuration risks. Backoffice Improvement The specialist will be encouraged to challenge processes that create unnecessary complexity and proactively raise improvement requirements with Product Owners and Business Analysts. The specialist will provide practical input into the design and improvement of Backoffice functionality, ensuring that new capabilities are built with the needs of configuration teams in mind and include appropriate safeguards to reduce the risk of client facing errors. Cross Functional Collaboration They will work closely with Integration Managers, Commercial teams, Product Owners and Business Analysts to ensure configuration requirements are clearly understood and delivered effectively. Prioritisation and delivery of changes requiring Product, Engineering or wider organizational support remain with the relevant functional owners. The specialist will also keep Integration leadership informed of recurring configuration challenges, operational risks and opportunities to improve the Backoffice experience. Essential Qualifications and Skills Experience, 1-2 years within iGaming, preferably within casino or live casino. Strong technical aptitude and a good understanding of casino and live casino platforms (Backoffice). Excellent knowledge of and confidence working with Backoffice and configuration systems. A strong understanding of how Backoffice configuration impacts client facing game and platform functionality. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when making changes within production environments. The ability to troubleshoot configuration issues and recognize when a change requires clarification or escalation. A good understanding of different platform environments, including development, testing, UAT and production. Experience working with Jira or similar task management tools. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple configuration requests accurately. The ability to understand requirements and clearly communicate configuration needs, risks and improvement opportunities. A proactive approach to identifying inefficient processes and proposing practical improvements. Desirable Experience supporting casino or live casino operator onboarding and portfolio management. Basic knowledge of scripting (Jenkins etc.) or automation. Experience working with processes or tools designed to reduce repetitive manual tasks. Personal Attributes Highly detail oriented, reliable and focused on delivering quality work. Technically curious and comfortable learning complex platform and backoffice functionality. You naturally look for ways to make processes simpler, faster and more scalable. Proactive when identifying risks and take pride in preventing client facing configuration issues. Confident challenging inefficient processes and advocating for better solutions when you see an opportunity to improve the way things are done. You take ownership of your work and are always looking for ways to improve how configuration tasks are performed. Comfortable working with production systems and understand the importance of following appropriate controls and validation processes. You work well with Integration, Commercial, Product and Business Analysis teams and can communicate clearly with both technical and non technical stakeholders. You understand the importance of balancing speed and efficiency with accuracy, control and quality. Comfortable working in a fast paced environment where priorities can change and multiple requests need to be managed effectively. What’s in it for you? Opportunities for personal growth and learning. An open, inclusive, and supportive team where you will be valued, and your suggestions are always welcome. 24 days of paid holiday per year, in addition to local public holidays. Life assurance (2× annual salary). Private medical insurance. €400 annual wellness allowance. €80 monthly lunch allowance. Team-building opportunities. Parking(limited). Local discounts and more
